title: Add RTVolumeRenderer skeleton and integrate RT Volume mode
purpose: Introduce a clean, RT-centric volumetric rendering path decoupled from legacy renderers.

steps.detail: Create src/systems/RTVolumeRenderer.h/.cpp with class skeleton: init, createHDRTarget, renderToHDR, composite, onSwapchainResized, cleanup. Provide RAII and Sync2 usage.
Add a new mode flag in Application (m_rtVolumeMode). Instantiate RTVolumeRenderer, wire into recordCommandBuffer: when enabled, skip mesh/point render and call RTV renderToHDR + composite.
Create an HDR color image R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT for RT volume output; composite to swapchain color with a simple fullscreen pass.
Log mode toggles and resource lifecycle; add throttled '[RTV] ...' messages.

acceptance: Mode toggles on/off cleanly; mesh/point paths unaffected when off
HDR target created and composited; black image initially (no marcher yet)
